business: SEGMENT: title companies, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
competitors_mentioned: Palm Beach Real Estate Title & Escrow
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough independent review information here to name one company as definitively “best.” **Integrity Land Title** is a reasonable first call: it has a West Palm Beach office and offers title searches, title insurance, escrow, and closing services. [Integrity Land Title](https://www.integritylandtitle.com/default.aspx?tabid=485)

You could also compare it with **Palm Beach Real Estate Title & Escrow**, which is located in West Palm Beach. [Company site](https://palmbeachrealestatetitleandescrow.com/)

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of fees, confirm they can meet your closing date and your lender’s requirements, and check recent reviews. In Palm Beach County, the purchase contract may determine who selects the title company, so check that first.
